Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for scheduling the SOC 2 controls walkthrough for next week. Two quick asks from my side:

2) Many of our evidence files are large — would Redwood be able to accept an SFTP handoff rather than transferring via Drive during the call? That will save time and avoid timeouts.

Proposed new slots (our timezone = EST):
- Thu Nov 4, 5:00pm - 6:00pm PST (Thu Nov 4, 8:00pm - 9:00pm EST)
- Thu Nov 4, 6:30pm - 7:30pm PST (Thu Nov 4, 9:30pm - 10:30pm EST)

If neither works we can look at Friday morning EST. I'm attaching an evidence_manifest.csv with the file list so you can size the SFTP folder.

Thanks — Jill

Regarding time: the earlier slot (5:00pm PST) should work for our core ops and controls leads, but Ben and Irene asked whether we can shrink the runbook portion to 30 minutes so we can keep it tight and cover the most critical artifacts. Proposed schedule:

- 5:00pm - 5:30pm PST: controls walkthrough (SOC 2 scope recap + key evidence map)
- 5:30pm - 6:00pm PST: live evidence handoff + Q&A (SFTP transfer confirmation)

If that looks ok to you, confirm and we'll send a calendar update with join info and an SFTP checklist.

Vivek

> We can absolutely accept an SFTP handoff. Ben will drop our SFTP instructions and a short checklist so your ops team can write files to a secure incoming folder prior to the call.

I've attached a tiny text file with exact SFTP paths and a short preflight checklist (redwood-sftp-instructions.txt). To summarize:

- We will provision a temporary incoming folder under sftp://sftp.acme.io/incoming/redwood (credentials will be delivered via our secrets channel).
- Please use the filename convention ACME_<case#>_<filename>.pdf to keep things tidy.
- When you finish the upload, reply to this thread with the folder path and the timestamp; we'll validate permissions and confirm receipt before the live Q&A.

Also, if you prefer not to exchange credentials over email, we can push a DocuSign-approved transfer authorization link (I can generate) and send the credentials after that completes.
